The '''1929–30 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s''' [[List of Real Madrid C.F. seasons|28th season]] in existence, and their [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|2nd consecutive season]] in the [[La Liga|Primera División]]. The club also played in the [[Campeonato Regional Centro]] (Central Regional Championship) and the [[Copa del Rey]].
